newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japan donates 26 toilets to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Japan donates 26 toilets to Philippines.

text.p: Japan made a 762,000-peso ($29,300) contribution on Friday to efforts to discourage Filipinos from relieving themselves in the street.
The cash will be used to build 26 public toilets in the Cordova district of the central Philippine island of Cebu.
The toilets will improve Cordova's "public hygiene and keep its environment clean and healthy," the Japanese Embassy said in a statement.
President Fidel Ramos, on a recent provincial tour, commended local officials for building a "five-star" public toilet, saying it would minimise instances of Filipinos urinating in public.
Many Filipino men habitually relieve themselves against walls, even in urbanised Manila.
